entities.name: Community-acquired pneumonia
observations: Radiographic pneumonia with fever, productive cough, leukocytosis, and right-middle-lobe infiltrate in a 27-week pregnant adult.
Pregnancy plus respiratory rate 30/min supports inpatient admission or monitored observation despite normal oxygen saturation and blood pressure.

entities.name: Ampicillin-sulbactam
observations: Standard beta-lactam option for nonsevere inpatient community-acquired pneumonia and generally compatible with pregnancy.

entities.name: Azithromycin
observations: Provides atypical-pathogen coverage as part of beta-lactam plus macrolide inpatient CAP therapy; commonly used in pregnancy.
Monitor for QT prolongation, interactions, and local macrolide resistance.

entities.name: Cefuroxime
observations: Pregnancy-compatible cephalosporin and reasonable alternative with azithromycin, but less directly supported than ampicillin-sulbactam in current adult inpatient CAP regimen lists.

entities.name: Levofloxacin
observations: Not preferred during pregnancy when effective beta-lactam plus macrolide alternatives are available.

entities.name: Doxycycline
observations: Not preferred during pregnancy when safer effective alternatives provide atypical coverage; tetracycline-class fetal tooth and bone concerns were noted.

entities.name: Piperacillin-tazobactam plus vancomycin
observations: Broad-spectrum therapy is not indicated for uncomplicated community-acquired pneumonia without validated MRSA or Pseudomonas risk factors or severe disease.
